asks.cta.nearby.description: C-05/C-08/C-22 button that opens the C-25 ask sheet (D-101)

asks.cta.shop.description: C-07 button that opens the C-25 ask sheet for one shop

asks.sheet.nearby.defaultMessage: We'll ask the shops near you if they have it.

asks.sheet.shop.defaultMessage: We'll ask this shop if it has it.

asks.sheet.item.description: C-25 item field label when there is no product

asks.sheet.privacy.defaultMessage: Shops see the item, the quantity and roughly how far you are. Never your name or number.

asks.sheet.noPlace.defaultMessage: Set your location so we know which shops to ask.

asks.sheet.signIn.description: C-25 send button when signed out; goes to C-10 and back with the fields kept

asks.error.limit.defaultMessage: You can send {n} asks a day. Try again tomorrow.
asks.error.limit.description: C-25 daily limit reached; n is ask_daily_limit

asks.error.limitPlain.defaultMessage: You've sent today's asks. Try again tomorrow.
asks.error.limitPlain.description: C-25 daily limit reached without the number

asks.error.open.defaultMessage: You already have an open ask for this.
asks.error.open.description: C-25 an open ask for the same item exists

asks.error.openLink.description: C-25 link to the open ask

asks.error.noShops.defaultMessage: No shops nearby can take an ask right now.
asks.error.noShops.description: C-25 no shop in range can take the ask

asks.error.storeUnavailable.defaultMessage: This shop is not taking asks right now.
asks.error.storeUnavailable.description: C-25/C-07 one copy for every reason the shop can't take it (01 §11.2)

asks.error.invalid.defaultMessage: Check the item and the quantity, then try again.
asks.error.invalid.description: C-25 the request was rejected as invalid

asks.error.failed.defaultMessage: We couldn't send your ask. Try again.

asks.ordersLink.description: C-13 link to the C-26 asks list

asks.back.description: C-26 back link to the list

asks.error.close.defaultMessage: We couldn't close the ask. Try again.

asks.empty.body.defaultMessage: When search finds nothing, ask shops nearby and their replies show up here.

asks.list.yes.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {# shop has it} other {# shops have it}}

asks.signedOut.title.defaultMessage: Sign in to see your asks

asks.signedOut.body.defaultMessage: Your asks and the shops' replies stay in your account.

asks.progress.defaultMessage: Asked {n, plural, one {# shop} other {# shops}} · {r} replied
asks.progress.description: C-26 progress line without a price

asks.progress.best.defaultMessage: Asked {n, plural, one {# shop} other {# shops}} · {r} replied · best {price}
asks.progress.best.description: C-26 progress line with the best price

asks.replies.description: C-26 accessible name of the Yes list

asks.waiting.defaultMessage: Waiting for shops. Most reply within {min} min.
asks.waiting.description: C-26 empty while open; min is ask_reply_window_min

asks.none.defaultMessage: No shop has it right now. We've told shops nearby people want it.

asks.reply.soonest.description: C-26 badge on the earliest ready-by

asks.reply.replied.description: C-26 reply age, e.g. Replied 4 min ago

asks.reply.noPrice.defaultMessage: Ask the shop for the price

asks.reply.held.description: C-26 time left on the replied price (mm:ss)

asks.reply.priceChanged.description: C-26 the replied price has ended; the current price follows

asks.reply.book.description: C-26 book this reply at checkout (C-11)

asks.reply.viewOrder.description: C-26 a booking from this reply is active

asks.reply.inStore.description: C-26 Yes from an in-store-only shop
